title: Cutaneous and Systemic Reactions to Metal Implants
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate if metal patch testing in metal allergic patients is useful for predicting the development of allergic skin disease or systemic symptoms in patients who recieve a metal orthopedic implant.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

1. Age ≥18 years with a history of metal allergy who require joint repair (hip, knee and/or shoulder)
2. Able to undergo patch testing

Exclusion Criteria

1. Patients on oral immunosuppressant medications within 4 weeks of patch testing or topical corticosteroids to the back within 1 week of patch testing
2. Patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding
